D.treatment: collaborative design in the RNS initiative

O.outcome_detail: relevance, feasibility, and sustainability of teacher collaborative design

cells.quote: Despite these limitations, teacher collaborative design was the result of teachers' exercise of agency and leadership as manifested by boundary crossing, artefacts, stories, and new routines or rituals. Based on these results teacher collaborative design proved to be relevant, feasible, and sustainable.
cells.note: The quoted finding is from the wiki entry because the supplied study text is truncated before the remote networked schools case and its findings. No comparison condition or effect size is reported.
